children: with an arm's-length vendor to acquire the district-sized Cobequid-Chedabucto Hydrogen Project in Nova Scotia.
The 45,967-acre property comprises 1,149 claim units situated directly adjacent to holdings held by active regional exploration firms, including Koloma and Quebec Innovative Materials Corp.

The deal further expands Makenita's multi-commodity footprint, joining its 102,110-acre Serpentinization Iron-Magnetite Project in Saskatchewan and the 22,665-acre Sisson West Tungsten Project in New Brunswick, which borders Northcliff Resources Ltd.

Under the terms of the agreement, Makenita will earn its interest through a phased combination of cash payments, equity issuances, and exploration commitments. Upon signing, the company will make an initial payment of CAD $11,490 in cash, issue 3M common shares, and grant 2.25M three-year warrants exercisable at $0.30 per share within seven business days.

Subsequent equity tranches of 500K common shares and 375K three-year warrants (exercisable at $0.30) are due at four months and eight months, respectively. Additionally, Makenita is required to fund a minimum of $150K in work expenditures on the property within the first year.
The agreement remains subject to standard regulatory approvals, with all issued shares and warrants subject to a four-month-and-one-day statutory hold period.

title: Makenita expands footprint adjacent to Koloma with Nova Scotia Hydrogen acquisition
